description_short: Parking for all idle vehicles in four sizes, with filters and maintenance bonuses.
description_long: Adds a dedicated Parking toolbar next to Vehicles with 48 transparent and paved parking areas: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, or 12 slots in Small, Medium, Large, and Super sizes. Idle, unassigned trucks, excavators, forestry vehicles, and compatible mod vehicles reserve fitting slots through interruptible low-priority jobs. Each area has a persistent many-vehicle-type filter. Transparent parking adds 5 percentage points of maintenance reduction; paved parking costs 10% fewer slabs than manual paving, blocks replacement tiles, and provides a 50% maintenance multiplier.
